name: Hide Copilot Taskbar Button
description: Hides the Copilot button from the Windows 11 taskbar.

name: Disable Windows Copilot Globally
description: Turns off the Windows Copilot assistant system-wide using policy.

name: Disable Windows Recall Snapshots
description: Prevents Windows from saving photographic snapshots of screen activities for Recall.

name: Disable Bing Web Search in Start Menu
description: Restricts Start menu search to local files, settings, and apps without querying Bing.

name: Enable Windows Game Mode
description: Prioritizes CPU and GPU resources for active games and suppresses background tasks.

name: Disable Xbox Game Bar Overlay
description: Disables the Game Bar overlay to prevent accidental opening and reduce background memory usage.

name: Disable Background Game DVR Recording
description: Stops Windows from constantly recording game clips in the background to eliminate disk and GPU write overhead.

name: Disable Pointer Acceleration (Enhance Pointer Precision)
description: Disables non-linear pointer acceleration for 1:1 true raw mouse input in games and desktop.

name: Disable Wi-Fi Sense Hotspot Reporting
description: Prevents Windows from automatically sharing known Wi-Fi network information with Microsoft services.

name: Disable NCSI Active Internet Probing
description: Prevents Windows from continuously pinging msftconnecttest.com to verify connectivity.
warnings: May cause Windows to report 'No Internet' or break captive portal detection on Wi-Fi networks.

name: Disable Auto-Connect to Suggested Open Wi-Fi
description: Prevents Windows from connecting silently to unencrypted open public Wi-Fi hotspots.

name: Restrict Delivery Optimization to Local Network Only
description: Stops Windows Update from uploading update packages to random computers across the public Internet.

name: Enable DNS over HTTPS (DoH) System Fallback
description: Configures Windows DNS client to prefer secure encrypted DNS over HTTPS queries when supported by resolver.

name: Disable Teredo IPv6 Tunneling
description: Disables obsolete Teredo transition protocol tunneling to reduce attack surface and prevent IP leaks.

name: Disable Transparency Effects
description: Turns off transparency on taskbar, Start menu, and windows to reduce GPU overhead.

name: Disable Window Minimize/Maximize Animations
description: Speeds up desktop responsiveness by eliminating window transition animations.

name: Enable Storage Sense Auto-Cleanup
description: Automatically frees up disk space by deleting old temp files and recycled items.

name: Disable Delivery Optimization Peer-to-Peer (HTTP Only)
description: Disables peer-to-peer distribution of Windows updates, downloading updates directly from Microsoft servers only.

name: Tune SvcHost Split Threshold
description: Groups system services into fewer svchost processes on systems with moderate RAM to reduce memory overhead.

name: Disable Automatic Maintenance Wake-Up Timers
description: Prevents Windows Automatic Maintenance from waking the PC from sleep during the night.

name: Prevent Search Indexing While on Battery Power
description: Pauses Windows Search background indexing while running on laptop battery to prolong battery life.

name: Disable NTFS Last Access Time Updates
description: Stops updating file timestamp metadata every time a file is read, reducing unnecessary disk I/O operations.

name: Disable 8.3 Short File Name Creation
description: Disables legacy MS-DOS short file name generation to speed up directory enumeration and file creation.

name: Disable Remote Differential Compression API
description: Disables legacy RDC protocol overhead to speed up local network file transfers on modern gigabit LANs.

name: Diagnostic Data Level
description: Reduces diagnostic data sent to Microsoft to the lowest allowed level.
effectNote: On Windows Enterprise and Education, this sets data collection to 0 (Security). On Windows Home and Pro, Windows treats 0 as 1 (Required diagnostic data).
warnings: Windows Settings will display 'Some settings are managed by your organization'. This is normal when Group Policy registry keys are set.

name: Disable Advertising ID
description: Prevents apps from using the advertising ID for relevant ads across experiences.

name: Disable Tailored Experiences
description: Stops Windows from offering personalized tips, ads, and recommendations based on diagnostic data.

name: Disable Activity History Publishing
description: Prevents publishing and syncing of user activity history across devices.

name: Disable Online Speech Recognition
description: Disables cloud-based speech services, keeping dictation and speech processing offline.

name: Disable Inking & Typing Data Collection
description: Stops sending typing and handwriting sample data to Microsoft for dictionary improvements.

name: Disable App Launch Tracking
description: Prevents Windows from tracking app launches to improve Start menu and search results.

name: Disable Feedback Frequency Prompts
description: Disables periodic popups asking for user feedback about Windows features.

name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
description: Disables automatic sending of crash dumps and error logs to Microsoft.

name: Disable Customer Experience Program (CEIP)
description: Disables participation in the Windows Customer Experience Improvement telemetry program.

name: Disable Cloud Clipboard Sync
description: Stops clipboard content from synchronizing across multiple Windows devices.

name: Disable Device Search History
description: Prevents Windows Search from saving local device search history.

name: Disable Lock Screen Tips & Spotlight Ads
description: Removes suggestions, tips, and promotional overlays from the Windows lock screen.

name: Disable Start Menu Suggested App Ads
description: Prevents Windows from displaying recommended app store suggestions in the Start menu.

name: Disable System Location Sensor
description: Disables hardware and software geolocation sensor overrides to prevent physical tracking.
warnings: Disables location sensor for apps like Maps, Weather, and Time Zone sync.

name: Deny Apps Access to Location by Default
description: Sets default capability store permission to deny apps access to user physical location.

name: Deny UWP Apps Access to Microphone by Default
description: Restricts UWP Store apps from silently listening to or accessing audio recording hardware.

name: Deny UWP Apps Access to Webcam by Default
description: Blocks background UWP applications from capturing video frames through connected webcams.

name: Deny UWP Apps Access to User Notifications
description: Blocks applications from intercepting or reading private notification listener messages.

name: Deny Apps Access to Account Information
description: Prevents installed apps from accessing user display name, picture, and account identifier.

name: Deny Apps Access to Contacts List
description: Blocks store and system applications from scraping address book contacts.

name: Deny Apps Access to User Calendar & Appointments
description: Prevents third-party apps from harvesting schedule and appointment calendar entries.

name: Deny Apps Access to Other Apps Diagnostic Info
description: Blocks third-party apps from querying memory and diagnostic stats of other running software.

name: Disable Remote Assistance
description: Disables Windows Remote Assistance (Easy Connect and invitation files) to close unsolicited remote help access.

name: Disable AutoRun & AutoPlay on All Drives
description: Prevents malicious executables on USB drives and external media from executing automatically.

name: Disable Windows Script Host (VBS/JS Scripts)
description: Blocks execution of standalone .vbs and .js scripts, preventing common malware vectors.
warnings: Can break software installers and administrative scripts relying on VBScript or JScript.

name: Enforce Windows SmartScreen via Policy
description: Enforces Windows Defender SmartScreen protection across the operating system via policy.
warnings: This setting is enforced by policy and locks the SmartScreen toggle in Windows Security settings.

name: Disable Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution (LLMNR)
description: Disables LLMNR on local networks to eliminate hash-stealing and man-in-the-middle poison attacks.

name: Disable Remote Desktop Inbound Connections
description: Disables incoming Remote Desktop connections on port 3389.
warnings: Remote Desktop to this PC will stop working.

name: Disable Camera Access on Lock Screen
description: Prevents anyone from launching or accessing the webcam when the computer is locked.

name: Restore Classic Right-Click Menu
description: Restores the Windows 10 full context menu in Windows 11 File Explorer without 'Show more options'.

name: Always Show Known File Extensions
description: Displays file extensions (.exe, .txt, .pdf) in File Explorer for transparency and security.

name: Show Hidden Files and Folders
description: Makes hidden files and folders visible in Windows File Explorer.

name: Open File Explorer to This PC
description: Configures File Explorer to launch into 'This PC' view instead of Quick Access / Home.

name: Enable 'End Task' in Taskbar Context Menu
description: Adds an 'End Task' option when right-clicking running applications in the taskbar.

name: Show Seconds in Taskbar Clock
description: Enables seconds display in the Windows system tray clock.

name: Enable Win32 Long Paths (>260 Chars)
description: Removes the historical 260-character path length limitation for Win32 file APIs.

name: Align Taskbar Icons to the Left
description: Moves Windows 11 taskbar icons to the left side like Windows 10.

name: Hide Gallery from File Explorer Navigation Pane
description: Removes the redundant 'Gallery' icon from the left navigation tree in Windows 11 File Explorer.

name: Hide Recent Files in File Explorer Home
description: Prevents recently opened files from cluttering the Quick Access and Home page.

name: Hide Frequently Used Folders in Quick Access
description: Stops Windows from automatically pinning frequently visited directories in File Explorer.

name: Display Full Folder Path in File Explorer Title Bar
description: Shows the complete directory path in the Explorer title bar for precise file navigation.

name: Disable Search Box Highlights & Illustrations
description: Removes daily Bing illustrations and web trending topics from the taskbar search box.

name: Hide Widgets Weather Icon from Taskbar
description: Hides the weather forecast and MSN feed widget button on Windows 11 taskbar.

name: Hide Microsoft Teams Chat Icon on Taskbar
description: Removes the integrated personal Teams Chat icon from the Windows taskbar.

name: Hide Task View Button from Taskbar
description: Removes the virtual desktop / Task View button from the Windows taskbar.

name: Disable Windows Welcome Experience After Updates
description: Stops Windows from presenting full-screen 'What's new' setup and promo screens after feature updates.

name: Disable Tips, Tricks, and Suggestions About Windows
description: Prevents Windows from generating informational popups and suggestions during normal desktop usage.

name: Hide Fast User Switching Option
description: Hides the Fast User Switching button from the Start menu and logon screen to avoid leaving background sessions open.

name: Exclude Hardware Drivers from Windows Update
description: Prevents Windows Update from automatically replacing your dedicated GPU or chipset drivers.

name: Prevent Forced Auto-Reboot While Logged On
description: Stops Windows Update from forcibly restarting your PC when updates install while you are logged in.

name: Notify Before Downloading Windows Updates
description: Configures Automatic Updates to AUOptions 2 (notify before downloading) to prevent unexpected bandwidth spikes.
warnings: Requires manual confirmation to download and install updates.

name: Block Delivery Optimization on Metered Connections
description: Prevents Windows Update from downloading or sharing update files when connected to metered networks or hotspots.

name: Enforce Active Hours Policy Against Mid-Day Restarts
description: Enforces smart active hours window (8 AM to 10 PM) so automatic restarts never interrupt daily activities.

name: Disable Optional Preview Updates & Beta Rollouts
description: Prevents installation of untested preview quality updates (C/D week optional releases).
